definitions.explanation: Bacteria that are no longer killed by an antibiotic that used to work on them. They spread when antibiotics are overused or not taken as prescribed.

examples.japanese: {耐性菌|たいせいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}→抗生物質：11089_kouseibusshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧すぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐性菌|たいせいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}む→生む：29531_umu⟧。

⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{耐性菌|たいせいきん}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がり→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Infections caused by drug-resistant bacteria are spreading in hospitals, making treatment difficult.

notes:
Short for ⟦{薬剤|やくざい}→薬剤：14100_yakuzai⟧{耐性菌|たいせいきん} (bacteria resistant to drugs), from ⟦{耐性|たいせい}→耐性：13917_taisei⟧ (resistance, tolerance) + ⟦{菌|きん}→菌：02682_kin⟧ (bacteria). A medical word that also appears in news and in doctors' advice to finish a course of antibiotics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{薬剤|やくざい}→薬剤：14100_yakuzai⟧{耐性菌|たいせいきん}: drug-resistant bacteria (full term)
- {多剤|たざい}{耐性菌|たいせいきん}: multidrug-resistant bacteria
- {耐性菌|たいせいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出現|しゅつげん}する→出現する：20928_shutsugensuru⟧: resistant bacteria emerge
- {耐性菌|たいせいきん}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: measures against resistant bacteria
